minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the Electric Avenue car wash with conditions, then reworked zoning accessory-use rules.
minutes.summary: The board closed the continued hearing on the car wash at 380-400 Electric Avenue and approved it with conditions such as phasing and construction hours. Most of the meeting was a workshop on rewriting Chapter 4 accessory uses and design standards. The board also voted to write to the Zoning Board of Appeals asking to join 40B discussions, and set a schedule for board vacancy interviews.

budget_items.what_was_said: The sewer commission was waiting on town counsel's opinion on how connection fees are calculated and on a response from Leominster about flows.
A member noted the wash would use a large volume of water yearly; the water district is fee-based so payments roughly match cost, and Leominster sewer is cheaper than Fitchburg.

decisions.decision: Phasing of the car wash project (car wash first, office building relocation after) to be memorialized in the certificate of approval.
Applicant encouraged to submit the relocated freestanding sign as a de minimis change if the Zoning Board of Appeals grants relief.
Board to interview vacancy applicants July 10; joint meeting with Selectmen July 18.
Planner to check with the fire chief about why the 200-person limit exists in the recreation district.
Bylaw priority list work aimed at a November special town meeting.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the car wash at 380-400 Electric Avenue with the conditions noted during the hearing.
Before approving, the board accepted the applicant's waiver requests as stated and closed the public hearing; no public comment was heard.
Phasing was set: the car wash is built first and the office building relocation follows, to be written into the certificate of approval.
Most of the meeting was a workshop on rewriting zoning accessory-use and design standards. It reached no resolution and was continued.
The board voted to ask the Zoning Board of Appeals to invite the Planning Board into conversations on 40B projects.

why_it_matters: The car wash approval sets what can be built on a commercial corner of Electric Avenue, and the conditions on phasing and construction hours govern how the work affects neighbors.
The accessory-use and design rewrite is aimed at a November special town meeting, so residents may be asked to vote on changed zoning rules.
Sewer connection fees and water use for the wash depended on a pending legal opinion and on Leominster's response about flows, which bear on sewer costs.
